topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the innate immune system identifies infections and cellular damage using molecular patterns and specialized pattern recognition receptor systems.

topics.label: Inflammatory leukocyte recruitment and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cell activation directs immune cell migration into tissues and can lead to systemic consequences such as sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and give rise to persistent or granulomatous inflammation.

topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic.
